subject: fix: resolve Ruby dependency security vulnerabilities by committing Gemfile.lock
body:
- Remove Gemfile.lock from .gitignore so it is tracked in the repo
- Pin github-pages gem to '~> 232' in Gemfile for reproducibility
- Commit clean Gemfile.lock (github-pages 232, jekyll 3.10.0) that passes bundle-audit with no vulnerabilities
- Add 'ruby' platform to Gemfile.lock for cross-platform compatibility

The root cause of the security vulnerability report was that Gemfile.lock
was excluded from the repo. Each CI run generated a fresh lock file that
could resolve to vulnerable gem versions. By committing a clean, audited
Gemfile.lock with pinned versions, future CI runs will use known-safe
dependency versions.

author: bamr87
subject: fix(quests): wrap GitHub Actions expressions in raw blocks to prevent Liquid parse errors
body:
Wrap code blocks containing GitHub Actions-style expressions with
{% raw %}...{% endraw %} to prevent Jekyll's Liquid engine from
attempting to parse them.

Files fixed:
- pages/_quests/0001/stack-attack.md: TSX JSX object spread {{ id: ... }}
- pages/_quests/1010/agentic-state-persistence-and-drift.md: toJSON() call
- pages/_quests/1011/agentic-multi-agent-orchestration-patterns.md: fromJSON() call
- pages/_quests/1001/agentic-safe-execution-and-error-handling.md: fix preview image path (/assets/ prefix)

These caused 'Liquid Warning: Liquid syntax error' which GitHub Pages
treats as hard errors in strict mode, failing the pages-build-deployment
workflow (runs #238 and #239).

Fixes #238 #239

author: bamr87
subject: fix(includes): wrap self-referential include examples in raw tags
body:
Liquid processes {% include %} inside HTML comments and code fences
before Markdown, so the usage examples in quest-graph.html and
quest-backlinks.html were re-invoking themselves on every render
causing 'stack level too deep' (SystemStackError) when GitHub Pages
processed CHANGELOG.md (which mentions the include in inline code).

Fixed by wrapping the example invocations with {% raw %}{% endraw %}.

author: bamr87
subject: fix(quests): scope quest validator to quest content + lift 6 borderline quests
body:
PR #301 CI surfaced two issues with the new quest validation gate:

1. Single-file validator mode (used by CI's changed-file loop) wasn't
   applying the same skip rules as directory mode. Level READMEs, codex
   examples, docs/, templates/, tools/, and ALL_CAPS report files were
   being scored as if they were quests, generating ~43 false-positive
   failures.

2. Six legitimate quests sat just below the new 70% score threshold
   because of missing enhanced frontmatter fields and/or a recommended
   Quest Prerequisites section.

Validator changes
- Add QuestValidator._is_non_quest_file() and call it at the top of
  validate_quest_file so CI's per-file mode matches directory mode.
- Skip files whose fmContentType is set and not equal to 'quest'.

Workflow changes
- Explicit grep filters in quest-validation.yml so README/INDEX/HOME and
  templates|tools|docs|codex|inventory|scripts paths never reach the
  validator (defence-in-depth alongside the validator skip).

Content lifts (6 quests, 69-69% -> 72-79%)
- Backfill missing enhanced frontmatter (quest_line, quest_arc,
  prerequisites, quest_dependencies, quest_relationships, learning_paths,
  rewards, validation_criteria) on 5 quests.
- Add a Quest Prerequisites section to
  pages/_quests/1100/agentic-guardrails-and-human-in-the-loop.md.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
